text:
raj: Heads up — 8 nodes in us-west2 failed to boot after the kernel bump to 6.6 and the driver deploy (565). They hang in initramfs. Saw this during canary.
amy: ugh, any logs?
raj: journal from one of the stuck nodes: 
```
[    2.345678] dracut-initqueue[123]: Starting dracut initqueue service
[    2.350000] dracut-initqueue[123]: Warning: failed to find /usr/lib/nvidia/current -> no module files
[    2.351000] systemd-modules-load[150]: Failed to find module 'nvidia'
[    2.360000] initramfs: Waiting for /dev/root...
```
raj: it gets dropped to BusyBox initramfs, not finishing initramfs hooks
mike: looks like the package that provides /usr/lib/nvidia/current symlink (nvidia-driver-common) didn't land for those images. Could be dkms postinst race with initramfs generation.
olga: Confirmed: image builder logs show dkms built the module but postinst didn't create the symlink before dracut ran.
amy: Which nodes? only us-west2 canary?
raj: canary pool only so far (8/120). Kernel 6.6 + driver 565 combo. Other regions fine.
SRE-bot: :rotating_light: Deploy check: rollout paused automatically at 8% due to boot-failure alarms. Rollout ID r-2026-03-18-565.
mike: quick mitigation: mark canary nodes unsched and rollback driver on the image (rebuild with driver pinned to 555) or rebuild initramfs to include modules earlier. Which is faster?
amy: Pin to 555 for now, rebuild images. We don't have time to change dracut hooks during rollout.
raj: agree. Also need a postmortem checklist entry: ensure dkms postinst and dracut ordering for future kernel bumps.
olga: For the stuck nodes, we can rescue by booting into rescue kernel and running:
```
# chroot /sysroot
# dkms status
nvidia, 565.12: installed
# update-initramfs -u -k all
# ls -l /usr/lib/nvidia/current -> /usr/lib/nvidia/565.12
```
olga: But for fleet scale that's manual.
amy: Action items: (1) pause rollout (done by infra-deploy-bot), (2) pin driver to 555 on canary images and reprovision, (3) add ci test that runs update-initramfs ordering smoke.
infra-deploy-bot: Rollout r-2026-03-18-565 paused by automatic failure policy at 1767777822. Suspending further canary nodes.
mike: Also add a short-lived systemd unit drop-in to delay dracut probing until dkms postinst completes? Could be brittle.
raj: I like the pin-and-rebuild approach for now. Can we get a fast image rebuild and reclaim the 8 nodes ASAP?
amy: I'll kick off an image rebuild now, pinning driver to 555 and forcing initramfs regen. ETA ~ 18 minutes.
SRE-bot: Noted: tagging incident as infra-gpu-boot-565-1767777777. Creating incident doc.
mike: Postmortem note: root cause = race between DKMS post-install hooks and initramfs creation on 6.6 image build; manifested only with new driver 565 which changed packaging layout (moved symlink creation timing).
raj: Thanks. After rebuild and verification we'll resume rollout with a canary of 2 nodes first and 15 minute soak.
amy: update: rebuild finished, smoke passed on 3 test nodes. Reprovisioning the 8. Will monitor.
raj: Nice. Keep watchers on node boot timestamps and ec2 console output.
olga: Follow-up: file to infra runbook: add check for /usr/lib/<driver>/current symlink during image bake and fail early.
mike: And add dkms postinst unit override to make it systemd-notify completion so dracut can wait if needed.
raj: ok closing for now once nodes are healthy. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
